text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion claims a magnificent victory 
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! Thunderous 
applause and cheers envelope her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every single moment of her run was pure 
brilliance. This victory was bound to be 
talked about for generations to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished an incredible race, Fine 
Motion shares a laugh with her Trainer 
about what to do tomorrow. Only a few 
months left until she returns home. 
There's still time...!
